setInventory-actor.label: Actor
setInventory-actor.tip: Set the inventory of this actor

increase-items.name: Increase Items
increase-items.tip:
Create a specified number of items and add them to the inventory,
merge them if the same item already exists, otherwise insert them into the frontmost empty position

decrease-items.name: Decrease Items
decrease-items.tip: Remove a specified number of items from the inventory

gain-equipment.name: Gain Equipment
gain-equipment.tip: Create an equipment and insert it into the frontmost empty slot of the inventory

lose-equipment.name: Lose Equipment
lose-equipment.tip: Remove an item from the inventory

gain-equipment-instance.name: Gain Equipment Instance
gain-equipment-instance.tip: Get the equipment from the equipment accessor and insert it into the frontmost empty slot of the inventory

lose-equipment-instance.name: Lose Equipment Instance
lose-equipment-instance.tip: Get the equipment from the equipment accessor and remove it from the inventory

swap.name: Swap Order of Items
swap.tip: Swap two item slots, or an item slot and an empty slot

sort.name: Sort Simply
sort.tip: Remove empty slots between items so that items are closely packed but do not change the order of items

sort-by-order.name: Sort by Filename
sort-by-order.tip: Remove empty slots between items so that items are closely packed and sort items in ascending order by file name

reference.name: Use Global Actor's Inventory
reference.tip: Set the specified global actor's inventory to this actor's inventory (shared)

reset.name: Reset
reset.tip: Clear items and money from the inventory

setInventory-equipment.label: Equipment
setInventory-equipment.tip: Get an existing equipment from the equipment accessor

setInventory-order1.label: Order A
setInventory-order1.tip: Order of item A in inventory (empty slot allowed)

setInventory-order2.label: Order B
setInventory-order2.tip: Order of item B in inventory (empty slot allowed)

setInventory-refActor.label: Global Actor
setInventory-refActor.tip: Get the inventory of this global actor for sharing
